title: finding(fields): `RetiredFieldTombstone` names the row's live `type` as retired when the retired spelling arrives through `widget`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it. The site is `RetiredFieldTombstone` in `@object-ui/fields`: the spelling it reports is inferred from the field it is handed, not from the key it was resolved under.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10176 (PR objectui#10469). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Reproduction (the dev's probe, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`FormPage` (internal route) rendered with real widgets on `main` at `808f33986`:
- A form-view field `{ field: 'who', widget: 'owner' }` over an object field of type `user` rendered `DIV[role=alert, data-retired-field-type="user"]` with the text "[object-ui] Field type `user` was retired."
- An object field `{ type: 'text', widget: 'owner' }` rendered `data-retired-field-type="text"` and "Field type `text` was retired."

So the refusal names a LIVE type as retired, and the migration prescription for the actual retired spelling (`owner`) is lost.

## Mechanism (source reading)

The tombstone takes its spelling from `props.field.type`, then `schema.type`, then `type`, and never from the key it was resolved under. `FormPage` resolves the row's widget key from `field.widget` first (`resolveFieldWidgetKey`, the `if (field.widget) return resolveFormWidgetType(field.widget);` line), so the tombstone is chosen for `owner`, but it is handed the row's live `field.type`. The record form also passes the raw metadata as `field`; that path is a source reading only, not measured at runtime.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix: the tombstone is told which spelling resolved to it, for example through a prop the resolver fills, instead of re-deriving it from the field. ⛔ No change to the retired-type table.
- Seam: `@object-ui/fields` `RetiredFieldTombstone` spelling inference ← its hosts (`FormPage`, the record form).

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `RetiredFieldTombstone` ⇒ objectui#10176 (the source card) and #9803 (an unrelated closed PR). `tombstone` near `widget` ⇒ only the source card, its PR, objectui#10457 and older unrelated items. `data-retired-field-type` ⇒ only PR objectui#10469. Must-hit control `tombstone` ⇒ 59 hits.

Dedupe words: `RetiredFieldTombstone widget owner wrong spelling` · `tombstone names field.type not widget` · `retired widget owner refusal says user was retired`
